Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a subtle increase in density and widening of the lower mediastinum with lateral displacement of the right paraspinal line, which is a classic radiological sign of a posterior mediastinal mass such as a neurogenic tumor. The other options describe findings (bilateral displacement, upper mediastinal involvement, pleural effusion, or vertebral destruction) that are not evident in this image.
